items.label: 合成舊版 if 分支
items.xml: <block xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml" type="controls_if"><mutation elseif="2" else="1"></mutation><value name="IF0"><shadow type="logic_boolean"><field name="BOOL">TRUE</field></shadow></value><value name="IF1"><shadow type="logic_boolean"><field name="BOOL">FALSE</field></shadow></value><value name="IF2"><shadow type="logic_boolean"><field name="BOOL">TRUE</field></shadow></value></block>

items.label: 合成四段文字串接
items.xml: <block xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml" type="text_join"><mutation items="4"></mutation><value name="ADD0"><shadow type="text"><field name="TEXT">saved-0</field></shadow></value><value name="ADD1"><shadow type="text"><field name="TEXT">saved-1</field></shadow></value><value name="ADD2"><shadow type="text"><field name="TEXT">saved-2</field></shadow></value><value name="ADD3"><shadow type="text"><field name="TEXT">saved-3</field></shadow></value></block>

items.label: 合成多項字串方塊
items.xml: <block xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml" type="string_generic"><mutation items="5"></mutation><value name="ADD0"><shadow type="string"><field name="TEXT">saved-0</field></shadow></value><value name="ADD1"><shadow type="string"><field name="TEXT">saved-1</field></shadow></value><value name="ADD2"><shadow type="string"><field name="TEXT">saved-2</field></shadow></value><value name="ADD3"><shadow type="string"><field name="TEXT">saved-3</field></shadow></value><value name="ADD4"><shadow type="string"><field name="TEXT">saved-4</field></shadow></value></block>
